constraints: Run after a matching build in an owned worktree. Uses existing compiler/linker/binutils and refuses variants if either full raw baseline does not reproduce. Protects production source, Ninja, pin config and raw objects by hashes.

Generated artifacts must be build/r67_sound*.json and sibling build-only files. PASS means the controlled experiment completed, not a source match or integrated TU ownership proof. Synthetic linking disables C++ exception metadata and uses default layout, not the production LCF.

Full-TU raw-function byte parity excludes relocation payloads. Typed-island datum checks resolve all32 own pointers at measured retail bases and do not certify production placement. Never integrate a table solely as pool-shaping padding.
name: r67-sound-boundary-probe
purpose: Reproduce sound raw Ninja baselines, compare whole-source TU boundaries and real literal/data context, and isolate linker sharing and MWCC data-pooling retention without production writes.
